I’m analyzing how the simulation scale set to 80 pixels per meter conflicts with responsive rendering that reduces it around 60 at typical screen widths. I want to balance honest scale reporting and keeping visuals (car, wall) fully visible without cutting off elements. Also, inspecting the layering of bricks in the wall is tricky since overlapping layers hide back ones heavily, and headless browser tools aren’t available for live inspection—so I’m relying on reasoning about the UI instead.
